DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 夜間の音について、録音もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you also have a recording of the nighttime noise?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、窓の外の音だけではありません。録っている間、私の部屋のテレビも付いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 外音録音に本人テレビ音混在を申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. However, it does not contain only sounds from outside the window. The television in my room was also on while I was recording.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your own television sound is mixed into the recording of outside noise. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 録音で聞こえる声が、すべて外の物とは言えないということですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So we cannot say that all the voices heard in the recording came from outside.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。歌声はテレビです。外で聞いたのは、短く繰り返す金属のような音でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歌声はテレビで外音は反復金属音と分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. The singing is from the television. What I heard outside was a short, repeated metallic sound.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the singing from the television from the repeated metallic noise outside. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身が直接聞いた時の場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell me where you were and what time it was when you heard it directly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨夜十一時ごろ、部屋の窓の近くでした。音がした建物の中は見えず、誰が出したかは知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 直接聴取時刻場所と発生者不明を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was near my room's window at about eleven last night. I could not see inside the building the sound came from, and I do not know who made it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State the time and place where you heard it directly and that you do not know who made it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 録音の長さや、同じ音が続いた時間は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you know the length of the recording and how long the same sound continued?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 録音は一分です。外の音はその前からありましたが、何分続いたかは時計を見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 録音一分と総継続時間不明を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The recording is one minute long. The outside noise had started before that, but I did not look at a clock to see how many minutes it lasted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish the one-minute recording from the unknown total duration. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 混ざった音も含めて記録を確認します。元の録音は残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will check the record, including the mixed sounds. Please keep the original recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 加工せず残します。テレビを消して録り直しても昨夜の証拠にはならないので、昨夜聞いた内容を説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原録保存と後日再現を昨夜記録にしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep it unedited. Recording again with the television off would not be evidence of last night, so I will explain what I heard last night.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the original recording and do not treat a later recreation as a record of last night. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 状況を順に伺います。それでは、お話しいただきありがとうございます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will ask about the circumstances in order. Thank you for telling us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お誕生日の便りをお送りになるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to send a birthday letter, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人の誕生日は来週です。今日出したら、誕生日まで郵便局で開けずに預かってもらえるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 誕生日まで郵便局が開封を待たせるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My friend's birthday is next week. If I mail it today, can the post office keep it unopened until the birthday?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the post office can make the letter wait to be opened until the birthday. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受取人が封を開ける日を、郵便局が決めるものではありません。配達の希望条件は別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The post office does not decide when the recipient opens the envelope. We will check your delivery preferences separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私が渡す時のように日を選べると思いました。外側に「誕生日に開けて」と書くのは、友人へのお願いなのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封日が受取人へのお願いと理解する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could choose the day as I would when handing it over myself. Writing 'Open on your birthday' on the outside is a request to my friend, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the opening date is a request to the recipient. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうです。郵便の宛先や取扱いの表示と、相手へのお願いは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's right. Please separate the postal address and handling instructions from requests to the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 到着日は送り方に応じて相談します。開ける日は友人へ別のメッセージで伝え、封筒の宛名へ混ぜません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 配達相談と友人開封連絡を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will discuss the arrival date according to the mailing method. I will tell my friend when to open it in a separate message and will not mix that into the address on the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate delivery arrangements from the message to your friend about opening it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今、送るご準備はできていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you ready to send it now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 便りは封筒へ入っています。友人にはもう「着いても来週まで待って」と送り、了承の返事が来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封入済と友人の開封待機了承を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The letter is in the envelope. I have already messaged my friend, 'Even if it arrives, wait until next week,' and received a reply agreeing to that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the letter is enclosed and your friend has agreed to wait before opening it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、発送の方法をご案内します。必ず誕生日当日に届くとのお約束ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then I will explain the mailing methods. We cannot promise it will arrive exactly on the birthday.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 承知しました。先に届いても誕生日後に届いても、配達と開封のお願いは別の話として友人と確認します。今日発送したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当日保証なしを理解して今日発送希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. Whether it arrives early or after the birthday, I will confirm with my friend that delivery and the request about opening it are separate matters. I would like to mail it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge there is no guarantee of birthday delivery and ask to mail it today. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、条件を確認して承ります。お気持ちが届きますように。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the conditions and accept it. I hope your good wishes reach your friend. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 毎月の引落しについて、どの点を確かめたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about your monthly direct debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 習い事の月謝が高いので、引落しを半額にできるか相談したいです。口座の残高を減らす方法ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 月謝引落半額変更を残高相談と区別して求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My lesson fees are expensive, so I would like to ask whether the direct debit can be reduced by half. I am not asking how to reduce my account balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about halving the lesson-fee direct debit, distinguishing this from an account-balance inquiry. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 月謝の金額変更は、教室との契約についての確認が必要です。教室へはご相談になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Changing the lesson fee requires checking your contract with the school. Have you discussed it with the school?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。銀行が引く金額を変えれば、教室への支払いも変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 銀行入力で契約額も変わる誤解を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I thought that changing the amount the bank debits would also change the payment to the school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your misunderstanding that changing the bank's entered amount also changes the contract amount. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 銀行で確認できる取引の内容と、教室が決める契約額は別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The transaction details the bank can check are separate from the contractual amount set by the school.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 教室へ回数を減らせるか聞きます。自分で半分だけ入金しておけば半額の契約になる、とも考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 教室へ回数照会し残高半額を契約変更としない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will ask the school whether I can reduce the number of lessons. I will also avoid assuming that depositing only half the amount myself would make it a half-price contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the school about fewer lessons and do not treat a half-sized balance as a contract change. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらへ確認したい取引は、いつの物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: When was the transaction you would like us to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今月五日の記録です。前月と同じ額だったか、通帳の行を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今月五日取引の前月比較を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is the record from the fifth of this month. I would like to check the line in my passbook to see whether the amount was the same as last month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to compare the transaction on the fifth of this month with the previous month. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この行の金額をご確認ください。契約上の請求理由は、教室へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the amount on this line. Ask the school about the contractual reason for the charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 前月と同額と分かりました。この記録は持ち帰り、教室へ来月から変えられる条件を相談します。銀行へ月謝を値引く依頼はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同額記録を受け教室へ来月条件照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see it was the same amount as last month. I will take this record home and ask the school about the conditions for changing it from next month. I will not ask the bank to discount the lesson fees.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the same-amount record and ask the school about conditions from next month. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、ご契約先へご確認ください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please check with the organization you have the contract with. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 配達したお買物についてのお問い合わせですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are inquiring about a shopping delivery, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 玄関前にこの店の袋がありましたが、今日は注文していません。家族の分かと思って、まだ中を出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未注文の配達袋と未開封を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: There was a bag from this store outside my door, but I did not place an order today. I thought it might be for my family, so I have not taken anything out yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report an unordered delivery bag and that it is unopened. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 注文の控えや、お名前の表示はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is there an order slip or a name on it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 外の紙に別の部屋番号があります。名前は私でも家族でもありません。紙の場所だけ見て、袋は開けていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別部屋番号別名と外紙だけの確認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The paper outside has a different room number. The name is neither mine nor a family member's. I only looked at the outside paper and have not opened the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the different room number and name and that you checked only the outside paper. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 配達担当へ確認します。いったん持ち主の物と分かるまで、使わずにおいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check with the delivery person. Please leave it unused until we establish whose property it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 使いません。隣の部屋の物だとしても、勝手に届け直さず、担当の方から確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 使用せず勝手な隣室再配達を避け担当照会する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not use it. Even if it belongs to the room next door, could you have the person in charge confirm it, rather than my delivering it there without permission?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not use it or redeliver it next door yourself; ask the delivery person to check. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。この窓口から担当へ連絡します。袋はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will contact the delivery person from this service desk. Where is the bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 玄関の内側へ入れました。外に置いたままにすると通路を塞ぐので、私が移した点も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通路を空けるため本人が内側へ移したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought it inside the front door. Leaving it outside would block the passage, so please also tell them that I moved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you moved it inside yourself to keep the passage clear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 配達担当が確認しに伺います。袋を置いた時の状態も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The delivery person will come to check. They will also ask about the state it was in when left there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受取り済みの自分の注文として扱わず、他の宛先の袋を移して保管した状況として説明します。来られる時間を聞いて待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人注文受領でなく誤配可能袋の保管と扱う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will explain that I moved and stored a bag addressed elsewhere, rather than treating it as my own order that I have received. I will ask what time they can come and wait.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Treat it as storing a possibly misdelivered bag, rather than receiving your own order. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、確認のご連絡をします。お知らせありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will contact you after checking. Thank you for letting us know. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 活動の写真を整理していらっしゃいますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are organizing photos of the activity, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分が作った飾りを載せたいのですが、後ろに子どもが写っています。その子に「載せていい」と言ってもらえばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子ども写真公開を本人返事で決めてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to post the decoration I made, but a child appears in the background. Is it enough to have the child tell me I can post it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can decide to publish a child's photo based on the child's own reply. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 子どもの返事だけで公開を決めず、主催者の案内をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please do not decide to publish based only on the child's reply; check the organizer's guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その子へ声を掛ける前に聞いてよかったです。写真はまだ誰にも送っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未照会未送信を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm glad I asked before speaking to the child. I have not sent the photo to anyone yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you have neither asked the child nor sent the photo. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の案内では、参加者が写る写真の公開はお控えいただいています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today's guidance asks participants to refrain from publishing photos showing participants.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では今の写真は公開しません。飾りを家で別に撮れば、参加者の顔を切り取って隠す必要もありませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公開をやめ家庭で作品のみ撮影へ切替える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will not publish this photo. If I photograph the decoration separately at home, I will not need to crop out or hide participants' faces either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide against publishing and switch to photographing only your creation at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身の作品だけ撮る場合も、ほかの方が入らないようお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Even when photographing only your own creation, please make sure no one else is included.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家へ持ち帰ってから机の上で撮ります。ここで子どもに場所を移るよう頼むことはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 子ども移動を求めず持帰り撮影を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will take it home and photograph it on a table. I will not ask the child to move somewhere else here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to take it home to photograph, without asking the child to move. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今の会の写真は、ご自身の記録として扱ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the photos of this gathering as your personal record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分のアルバムに残し、公開用とは分けます。新しい写真には今日作った物と書き、会の参加者が写る物は添えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 個人記録と公開用作品写真を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep them in my own album, separate from photos for publication. I will label the new photo as something I made today and will not attach any photos showing participants at the gathering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Separate personal records from photos of your creation intended for publication. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご配慮ありがとうございます。それでは、作品をお持ち帰りください。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your consideration. Please take your creation home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 大きなお荷物について、ご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like advice about your large piece of luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券売機へ行く間、ここで箱を見ていてもらえますか。箱が重いので、また持って移動するのが大変です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 購入中の重箱見守りを案内所へ頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Could you watch this box here while I go to the ticket machine? It is heavy, so carrying it around again is difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the information desk to watch a heavy box while you buy tickets. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この案内所では、荷物をお預かりして見守るサービスは行っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This information desk does not provide a service for taking custody of and watching luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では箱を置いて離れません。妻が一緒にいるので、私が箱を持ったまま待ち、妻が切符を買う形にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 預かり不可を理解し同行妻と分担する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I will not leave the box unattended. My wife is with me, so I will wait holding the box while she buys the tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Acknowledge that luggage cannot be left here and divide the tasks with your accompanying wife. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お二人の行き先と人数を、購入前に共有してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please make sure you both know the destination and number of travelers before buying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二人とも同じ行き先です。箱の分の条件を確認する必要があるかは、私が寸法を示して聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同じ行先人数と箱条件の確認を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: We are both going to the same destination. I would like to show the box's dimensions and ask whether any conditions for the box need checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your shared destination and number of travelers, and offer to check the conditions for the box. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 大きさや内容によって取扱いが異なりますので、担当が確認します。箱を開ける前に、内容をお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Handling differs according to size and contents, so the person in charge will check. Please tell us the contents before opening the box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自宅で使う小さい棚を分解した物です。刃物や液体は入っていません。箱を勝手にホームへ置いて先に確認を取ることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 分解棚内容と現場放置しない方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It contains a small shelf for use at home that I have taken apart. There are no blades or liquids inside. I will not leave the box on the platform on my own and then go to get confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it contains a dismantled shelf and that you will not leave it unattended there. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当がこちらで確認します。購入は確認を終えてからでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will check here. Is it all right to buy the tickets after the check is finished?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。妻にも切符をまだ買わず戻ってもらいます。荷物の取扱いが分かったら、一人が箱を持ち、もう一人が購入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 妻の購入を止め確認後分担すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will also ask my wife to return without buying the tickets yet. Once we know how the luggage will be handled, one of us will hold the box and the other will buy the tickets.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Stop your wife's purchase and decide to divide the tasks after checking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、お荷物の条件を確認します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will check the conditions for your luggage. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今回のお住まいについて、ご家族もご一緒でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will your family be living with you at this address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今住んでいるのは私だけです。来月母が来る予定ですが、まだ日が決まっていません。今日から二人と書いてよいか迷います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 現在単身と母の将来予定を分けて相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I live there now. My mother plans to come next month, but the date has not been decided. I am unsure whether I can write that there are two residents starting today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for advice, distinguishing your current single occupancy from your mother's future plans. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 現在の状況を、まずお伝えください。予定だけで、今日すでに住んでいると書かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, please tell us the current situation. Do not write that she already lives there today based only on plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人で住み始めた日は月曜です。母は今も別の家にいて、荷物もまだ運んでいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人入居月曜と母未移動を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I began living there alone on Monday. My mother is still at another house, and she has not moved her belongings yet either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State that you moved in on Monday and your mother has not moved yet. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お母様が来る時の手続きは、その方の状況を確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check your mother's circumstances and explain the procedures for when she comes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 母の必要な手続きを私が全部決めず、本人へ案内を渡したいです。今日の私の届け出とは別に説明をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人届出別に母本人へ渡す案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than deciding all my mother's necessary procedures myself, I would like to give her the guidance. Could I have an explanation separate from my own notification today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for guidance to pass to your mother herself, separately from your own notification. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今日の担当から、将来の相談先もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Today's staff member can also tell you whom to consult about the future arrangements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。母の来る日が遅れるかもしれないので、来月一日と仮に記入して済ませないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 母日程未定で仮の日付を確定扱いしない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. My mother's arrival may be delayed, so I will not simply enter the first of next month as a provisional date and consider it settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your mother's schedule is undecided and do not treat a provisional date as final. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、まずご本人の現在のお住まいを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then first we will confirm your own current residence.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私の入居日と住所はこちらです。母の予定は未定と伝えたまま、今日の用紙へ母が入居済みとは書きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現住所入居日を示し母入居済と書かない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Here are my move-in date and address. I will continue to say my mother's plans are undecided and will not write on today's form that she has already moved in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show your current address and move-in date without writing that your mother has already moved in. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。それでは、現在のご状況で担当へおつなぎします。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Then we will connect you to the person in charge based on your current situation. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯の音を控えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you please keep your phone quiet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 仕事の連絡を一件待っています。全ての通知を切ればよいと思いましたが、仕事用の電話だけまだ鳴る設定でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知停止後も仕事着信が鳴ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am waiting for one work-related message. I thought turning off all notifications would be enough, but calls to my work number were still set to ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that work calls still ring after notifications have been turned off. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診察室では、音が出ないようお願いします。どうしても連絡が必要な事情ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please ensure it makes no sound in the examination room. Is there a reason you absolutely need to communicate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同僚へ引継ぎの返事をする予定です。診察中に出たいのではなく、診察前に連絡して終えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 引継ぎ連絡を診察前に済ませたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I plan to reply to a colleague about a handover. I do not want to answer during the examination; I would like to contact them and finish before the examination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you want to finish the handover communication before the examination. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 待合から離れる前に受付へお声掛けください。お電話のできる場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please tell reception before leaving the waiting area. We will show you where you can make a call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ここで話し続けず、場所を確認してから同僚へ私が受診中だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通話場所を確認し同僚へ受診を連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I will not continue talking here; I will check the location first and then tell my colleague that I am at a medical appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check where you can make a call and tell your colleague you are at a medical appointment. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 戻られたら、受付へ戻ったことをお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: When you return, please let reception know you are back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 電話を終えて戻りました。同僚が引継ぎを受けたので、仕事用の着信も音が出ないようにしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 復帰報告と引継ぎ済消音を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have finished the call and returned. My colleague has taken over, so I have also silenced calls to my work number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report your return, the completed handover, and that calls are silenced. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お戻りを確認しました。次は診察の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We have confirmed your return. Please wait to be called for your examination next.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 待ちます。診察が始まってから急いで設定を変えるのではなく、今のうちに画面も閉じてかばんへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内待機前に端末を収納する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait. Instead of hurriedly changing the settings after the examination begins, I will close the screen and put the phone in my bag now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put the device away before waiting to be called. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご対応ありがとうございます。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくした物は、どのような物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of item did you lose?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どものぬいぐるみです。頂き物で値段が分からないので、金額の欄に高い額を想像して書くのは迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 贈物ぬいぐるみ価格不明を推測記入せず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is my child's stuffed toy. It was a gift, so I do not know the price, and I am hesitant to guess a high amount and write it in the value field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the unknown price of a gifted stuffed toy without entering a guessed amount. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 分からない項目は、その旨をお伝えください。見分けられる特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell us if there are details you do not know. We will ask about identifying features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 灰色のうさぎで、耳の付け根に私が縫った黄色い糸があります。買った時からの模様ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 灰うさぎ耳の本人修繕黄色糸を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a gray rabbit, with yellow thread that I sewed at the base of its ear. It is not a pattern that was there when it was bought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the gray rabbit and the yellow thread you used to repair the base of its ear. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所と、なくしたと気付いた場所は同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Is the place where you last saw it the same as where you realized it was missing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 最後は駅前の椅子で抱いていました。気付いたのは家です。駅で落とした場面を見たわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 最後目撃駅と不在認知自宅を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The last time, my child was holding it on a seat in front of the station. We realized it was missing at home. I did not actually see it being dropped at the station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the last sighting at the station from noticing its absence at home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 駅や途中で寄った場所への問い合わせはされていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you asked the station or places you stopped along the way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駅には私から聞きましたが、まだ該当する物はないそうです。子どもに一人で探しに戻らせることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 駅照会結果と子の単独探索を避ける方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked the station myself, but they say nothing matching it has turned up yet. I will not send my child back alone to search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the station's response and your decision to avoid having the child search alone. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご連絡先と、特徴を記録します。写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record your contact details and the toy's features. Do you have a photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家で撮った写真があります。縫った糸も写っているので提示します。値段不明でも、子どもに必要な物として探す相談を続けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 糸が写る写真で価格不明のまま探索相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have a photo taken at home. It also shows the sewn thread, so I will show it to you. Even though the price is unknown, I would like to continue discussing how to find it as something my child needs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use a photo showing the thread to continue asking about a search while keeping the price unknown. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 写真とお話を確認します。それでは、届出の担当へご案内します。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check the photo and your account. Then we will direct you to the person who handles reports. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 贈物の箱をお送りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending a gift box, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。母へ贈る手袋を入れましたが、値段のカードも一緒です。金額を知らせたいわけではないので、差し出す前に取りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 母への贈物内の価格カードを差出前に除きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I put in gloves as a gift for my mother, but the price card is in there too. I do not intend to tell her the price, so I would like to remove it before handing the box over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to remove the price card from your mother's gift before mailing it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、中身はご自身でご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We have not accepted it yet, so please check the contents yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードを取りました。商品の使い方が書かれた紙は残します。値段を隠すために説明まで全部捨てるところでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 価格カードのみ除き使用説明を残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I removed the card. I will leave the paper explaining how to use the product. I almost threw away all the instructions as well to hide the price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Remove only the price card and keep the instructions for use. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送に必要な品名などの記載は、贈物の中のカードとは別に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check the item description and other information needed for shipping separately from the card inside the gift.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 送り状へ何も書かなくてよいという意味ではないのですね。必要な項目は、こちらの案内で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 内カード除去と必要外記載を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: So it does not mean I can leave the shipping label completely blank. I will check the required fields using your guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish removing the inner card from the required information on the outside. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お送りになる先は国内でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Are you sending it to a domestic address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、国内です。外国向けの贈物に必要な記載と混ぜず、この発送の条件で聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 国内発送と海外条件を混同せず尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, within the country. I would like to ask about the conditions for this shipment without mixing them up with information required for gifts sent abroad.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask without confusing domestic shipping with overseas requirements. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: では、ご自身で中身を戻して封をした後、受付条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then after you replace the contents and seal it yourself, we will check the acceptance conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手袋と説明紙を戻し、価格カードは自分のかばんにしまいました。箱を封じたので、国内の送り方を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手袋説明封入と価格カード持帰り後に発送相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I put the gloves and instruction sheet back and placed the price card in my own bag. I have sealed the box, so I would like advice about domestic mailing methods.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After enclosing the gloves and instructions and keeping the price card to take home, ask about mailing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、現在の条件をご案内します。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-25214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then we will explain the current conditions. Goodbye.
